text:
mia: Heads-up: prepping internal RN for runtime patch v0.45.2 — small mem-growth fix + safer cache eviction. Deploy window tonight 22:00 PT. Draft below, PTAL. :rocket:

mia: Draft release-note blurb (internal):
- What: v0.45.2 runtime patch (memory growth under specific long-lived chat sessions)
- Impact: No API changes. Reduced OOM risk for long sessions. No data migration.
- Rollback: auto-fallback to v0.45.1 if canary fails per thresholds.

olivia: small nit — call out that embeddings and model configs unchanged. otherwise looks good. :+1:

nico: confirm there's no JVM/GC flag changes?

mia: no JVM/GX flags, pure fix in kv-cache eviction logic. nothing to GC-tune.

sanjay: Suggest add explicit rollback criteria in RN + ops doc: if canary error rate > 1.5% OR p99 latency regresses > 200ms for 5m window -> rollback to v0.45.1. Also: if Redis misses spike > 5% over baseline during canary -> rollback.

ops-oncall: noted. i'll be on-standby 21:30-23:30 PT. Will watch canary metrics and have rollback playbook ready. @mia please pin runbook link in the announce. :eyes:

mia: adding runbook snippet to the internal announce. also pinning model/runtime image: rwinf/runtime:v0.45.2-rc1 (canary) -> rwinf/runtime:v0.45.2 (stable). We'll explicitly pin dedicated customers to v0.45.1 until full ramp.

olivia: Can we add a one-liner for Customer Success to paste? "No customer action required; we fixed an internal memory regression that could impact very long sessions." keeps it simple.

mia: added that line. final internal blurb below (copy for #all-hands/internal digest):
"Tonight at 22:00 PT we will deploy v0.45.2, a runtime patch addressing memory growth in long-lived chat sessions. No API or model changes. Canary at 10% for 30m -> ramp to 50% for 20m -> full rollout. Rollback triggers: error rate >1.5% or p99 latency +200ms sustained 5m, or Redis miss spike >5%. @ops-oncall will monitor; no customer action required."

sanjay: LGTM. Add a short ops checklist in the thread so oncall can run rollback quickly (commands + service names).

mia: adding checklist quick commands:```
# rollback to previous image
kubectl set image deployment/rwinf-runtime rwinf-runtime=rwinf/runtime:v0.45.1 -n inference
# scale down canary
kubectl scale deployment/rwinf-runtime-canary --replicas=0 -n inference
```

ops-oncall: perfect. i'll attach these to the runbook and keep phone hot.

deploy-bot: @mia scheduled deployment v0.45.2 at 2024-07-24T22:00:00-07:00 (queue pos 1). Canary panel auto-create: rwinf-canary-0.45.2

olivia: quick ask — can we gate the public announce until tomorrow AM? want CS time to triage any inbound.

mia: yes — internal note goes out now, public blast blocked until 08:00 PT tomorrow. I'll update the comms doc.

nico: minor idea — include a perf micrograph in the internal RN showing mem growth before/after, helps triage.

mia: good call. attaching screenshot to the internal doc before sending. :white_check_mark:

sanjay: one last operational check: confirm autoscaler thresholds unchanged (we're not changing HPA).

mia: confirmed — no HPA or scaling config changes.

ops-oncall: standing by. ping me when canary starts. :rotating_light:

deploy-bot: canary rollout will emit events to #eng-oncall and this thread.

mia: thanks team — finalizing and will post internal blurb + runbook link in 10m.

olivia: :thumbsup: good luck!
